Results.ReviewText:
A great quality grill in both design and construction.  Only 10 minutes for unpacking and assembly.
No need to refill bulky heavy propane tanks as this grill uses disposable 1 Lb. propane tanks and has electric starter. Placed on top of Weber grill cart it is easy to move around to channel smoke away when grilling.
Results.Title: Quality And Convenience

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill 3 weeks ago and have found it to be excellent at grilling food at an even, consistent temperature. I was greatly impressed with the careful packaging, the excellent design of the entire grill and the great guidance for assembly. The assembly took me less than 10 minutes with the instruction booklet on my workbench. I find the grates to be well designed and thick enough to maintain a consistent temperature. I like the fold-out trays on each side of the grill. This gives two places to rest plates of food as you " load" the grill. I highly recommend this grill for a one or two person household. The quality of the grill is excellent.
Results.Title: A great grill for a small household

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this a few weeks ago and took it in our travel van. We cooked steak, chicken breasts, fish, potatoes and all kinds of other things. It really worked well. The temperature gauge is a must have feature and I noticed it maintained its heat very well even when I opened it to flip something over. I'll admit I used some AI prompts on timing of some of the meats and sure enough, everything came off the Weber fully cooked and quite delicious. I also purchased an adapter kit so I can run it off my travel van's onboard liquid propane. Weber is the best company on the market for this and has excellent support!
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 is dialed in perfectly (5 Stars)

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size grill for RV travel and 4 family member dinners at home. Cooks great, fast heating and nice sleek looking design.  Bonus, the heating temperature and time for specific meats that comes with it has been spot on so far.
